image_description: A close-up of a large, spherical soap bubble floating against a blurred, warm-toned background. The bubble exhibits strong iridescence with swirling patterns of cyan, magenta, yellow, and green on its upper surface. It has a glossy, reflective quality, showing distorted reflections of the environment and bright specular highlights. A small droplet or secondary bubble formation is visible attached to the right side.

The internal reflections and refractions at the bottom of the bubble are somewhat muddy and lack the precise optical clarity of a real glass-like sphere, though this may be due to the complexity of the background rather than an AI error.
